name: Human vs AI: Birthday Party Battle
description: Come up with creative birthday party ideas, then see them paired against AI ideas — can you spot the impostor?

rules.message:
Welcome to Human vs AI: Birthday Party Battle!

You'll each create a unique birthday party idea. Then the AI will also write some ideas. In each round, you'll see TWO ideas side by side — one human, one AI — and guess which is which. Points for spotting the AI!

Make your idea detailed and creative (at least 240 characters).

collect-ideas.prompt: Describe a unique and creative birthday party idea! Make it detailed and interesting (at least 240 characters).

processing.message: Great ideas! Now the AI is writing its own party ideas to mix in. Let's see if you can tell them apart...

aiInject.instruction: Generate creative, detailed birthday party ideas (at least 240 characters each). Match the tone, detail level, and creativity of the real student submissions. Make each idea unique — mix whimsical, sophisticated, and adventurous themes. Do NOT make them obviously AI-generated.

results-announce.message: All matchups complete! Let's see who has the sharpest AI detector...

end.message: Thanks for playing Human vs AI: Birthday Party Battle!

recommendedFor: Great hook for an AI-literacy unit — students see firsthand what AI is and is not good at.
